claim: Nine models cover three datasets and three seeds; Phase 2 and Phase 3 are complete.
All nine models pass the clean-only criterion; the full gate blocks four and passes five.
Clean full-test metrics are reported as three-seed mean±standard deviation.
The frozen gate thresholds are clean recall≥0.95, robust recall≥0.80, ASR≤0.20, and recall drop≤0.20.
The policy was calibrated on validation evidence and then applied to test artifacts.
evidence_field_or_rows: calibration split and frozen policy provenance
